fields.name: classes
fields.label: Mode
fields.description: Choose light or dark colour scheme for the page background and navigation controls.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.description: Slide heading — displayed as an h2 (max 60 characters).

validation.customErrorMsg: Title is required and must be between 1 and 60 characters

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.description: Optional sub-heading displayed below the title (max 80 characters).

fields.name: link
fields.label: CTA Link
fields.description: Optional call-to-action link. The link text is used as the button label.

fields.name: background-image
fields.label: Background Image
fields.description: Optional background image (cover crop). When set, overrides the background colour field.

fields.name: background-color
fields.label: Background Colour
fields.description: Optional CSS colour (e.g. #002855) or gradient (e.g. linear-gradient(90deg, #002855, #003D7A)). Ignored when a background image is set. Leave blank to use the default brand palette by slide index.
